reader.requirement: At --std 85 the files a USE statement names explicitly, or reaches through INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O or EXTEND, may be of any mix of organizations and access modes; the compiler must accept the list and dispatch the procedure for each such file, while still refusing a file-name in two USE statements and a mode phrase used twice.

edition-consulted.switches: 1985 required words AFTER/PROCEDURE and the 2002 Format 3/4 gates; nothing about the files' organization

reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf28_01 covers explicit sequential+relative and INPUT over sequential+indexed; dynamic access, a five-file mixed list and the duplicate refusals are not exercised

probes.printed: USE ON SQ RL IX IR NX (sequential, relative dynamic, indexed dynamic, indexed random, indexed sequential) fires for SQ 38, IR 23 and NX 35; INPUT USE fires for OPTIONAL relative MS at end 10; the statement after each continues
probes.expected: GR5 a/b for each file; GR6 returns after a non-critical status

probes.printed: COBOL0897 file 'RL' already has a USE procedure
COBOL0897 this open mode already has a USE procedure
COBOL0877 USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION requires COBOL-2002 and COBOL0878 for EC-I-O
probes.expected: Format 3 is not in the 1985 text

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR5  (4.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5
OK  §1985:VII.4.6.4 GR5  (4.6.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: DeclBindUse collects any visible non-sort file without an organization test, and the dispatch keys on the file or the open mode, so mixed lists bind and fire. The duplicate-file and duplicate-mode refusals cite §2023:14.9.49.3 SR8/SR7 at --std 85 (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: u3.cob (runs/u3-001): USE ERROR ON EXTEND over a sequential and a relative-sequential missing file fires for each (35, 35) in order; USE ERROR ON IX (indexed dynamic) and USE EXCEPTION ON INPUT: OPEN INPUT IX RR fires USE-IX for IX only (GR4 explicit file wins) and USE-INPUT for the relative random RR; USE ERROR ON OUTPUT fires for an indexed random WRITE duplicate key (22) with no INVALID KEY phrase; each statement after continues. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR5 'implicitly or explicitly referenced in the USE statement need not all have the same organization'; OK §1985:VII.4.6.4 GR4 'no other USE statement applies to file-name-1'.
